title: MCP delete_record / delete_records: measure whether a delete goes to the recycle bin, and make the tool text say so
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#3826, phase 1. Ruled on objectstack-ai/cloud#3826 by the account owner in seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`: 「3826 照建议（征询版）」 (decision request 6890278459 and the revised D1 that follows it). Priority per the owner: 「分拆的任务能否直接标记为高优先级让车队开放」. It is the evidence for D3: whether MCP deletes also need human confirmation.

## 维护者速读

1. **要做的**：实测外部 AI 通过 MCP 删除记录时，记录是否进回收站、保留多久、能否恢复，并把工具说明改成如实描述（现在写的是「永久删除」）。
2. **为什么**：如果删除可以恢复，MCP 删除就暂时不需要真人确认；如果不能恢复，再议。
3. **需要你做的**：无。

## Facts

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:3091` still describes delete as permanent. The recycle bin is live (#30237, #30239; `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/`). Whether MCP deletes enter it is unmeasured.

## Change

Measure on a real kernel: record the reading on this card, correct the tool text and return value, and add a test.
